deploy-bot: kicking off v2 staged rollout: slice=4 initial=4% target=15% window=2h. /deploy start
Nadia: Note — edge proxies still have older header coalescing. recommend slow ramp and client pin for older SDKs.
Omar: Canary looked clean in us-east-1, but ap-south-1 had a transient increase in 429s during load test (0.6%).
deploy-bot: Canary metrics:
```
ap-south-1 429_rate: 0.6% (threshold 0.3%)
us-east-1 429_rate: 0.02% 
p95 latency: +12ms
```
Tess: Pause global ramp. Apply regional routing: ap-south -> v1 for tenant matches legacy-*. Also enable sticky header for mobile-agents.
Juan: Ops oncall — applying routing now. If fallback doesn't stabilize in 5m we trigger revert. Also setting short alarm: if 429>0.4% or errors 5xx>0.3% auto-hold.
deploy-runner: Policy applied: ap-south-1 -> v1 filters=`tenant:legacy-* OR client:mobile-ua`. policy_id=rp-4040
Nadia: I'll update the release notes: "v2 changes header normalization and request signal; older SDKs may be routed to v1. See migration guide." Sending SDK patch request to mobile team.
Omar: After routing, ap-south 429 dropped to 0.08% in 3m. p95 back to baseline. ready to cautiously resume to 8% in 10m.
Tess: +1. Schedule next ramp to 8% at 1748001712 UTC. Keep pins until next SDK patch. Auto-hold configured.
Juan: ops-ack. Keeping thread open for 15m monitoring. If stable, we proceed with staged rollout. If not, full rollback is ready.
Nadia: I'll post a condensed note to #release and include the temporary pin and rollback snippet.
deploy-bot: rollout state: global=4% (ap-south pinned->v1). next_ramp=8% at 1748001712.
